==Buildings and structures==
===Buildings===
[[File:Tomb of Bibi Jawindi Uch Sharif.jpg|thumb|[[Tomb of Bibi Jawindi]]]]
[[File:Scala Contarini del Bovolo (Venice).jpg|thumb|upright|Spiral staircase, [[Palazzo Contarini del Bovolo]], Venice]]
* [[St Edmund's Church, Southwold]] in England is completed.
* Church of [[St. Valentin, Kiedrich]] in [[Hesse]] (Germany) is completed.
* 1490
** [[Bara Gumbad]] in [[Delhi]] is built.
** Probable completion of rebuilding of [[Sherborne Abbey]] [[Choir (architecture)|choir]], [[England]], with a [[English Gothic architecture#Perpendicular Gothic|Perpendicular style]] [[fan vault]] by [[William Smyth (architect)|William Smyth]].<ref>{{cite book|author=The Friends of Sherborne Abbey|title=The Abbey Church of St. Mary the Virgin, Sherborne|edition=12th|date=May 1959|publisher=Sawtells of Sherborne}}</ref>
** [[All Saints' Church, Wittenberg]] (''Schloßkirche''), designed by [[Conrad Pflüger]], begun.
** Former [[Nea Ekklesia]] church in [[Constantinople]] destroyed by a lightning strike.
* 1493 – [[Tomb of Bibi Jawindi]] at [[Uch]] in the [[Punjab region]] is built.
* 1495 – [[Monastery of Jesus of Setúbal]] in Portugal, designed by [[Diogo de Boitaca]], is completed.
* 1497 – Rebuilding of [[Holy Trinity Church, Long Melford]] in England is completed.
* 1497 – [[Santa Maria delle Grazie (Milan)|Santa Maria delle Grazie]] in [[Milan]], Italy is completed.
* 1498 – [[Church of St Martin, Landshut]], [[Bavaria]] (Germany) is completed by [[Hans von Burghausen]].
* 1499
** Garden loggia and external spiral staircase at [[Palazzo Contarini del Bovolo]] in Venice, probably designed by Giorgio Spavento, completed.
** Start of construction of Abbaye de la Trinité, [[Vendôme]].<ref>{{cite book|first=Ian|last=Sutton|title=Architecture, from Ancient Greece to the Present|location=London|publisher=Thames & Hudson|year=1999|isbn=978-0-500-20316-3|url-access=registration|url=https://archive.org/details/westernarchitect00sutt}}</ref>

==Births==
* c. 1495 – [[Diego Siloe]], Spanish [[Renaissance architecture|Renaissance architect]] and sculptor (died [[1560s in architecture|1563]])

==Deaths==
* 1490 – [[William Smyth (architect)|William Smyth]], English architect
* c. 1493 – [[Enna Swarviski]] (born c. [[1427 in architecture|1427]])
* 1494 (last record) – [[Luca Fancelli]], Italian architect and sculptor (born c. [[1430 in architecture|1430]])
